response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrable experience in GenAI, RAG architectures, vector databases, or cloud-based AI system deployment — core requirements for the role — and while they have broad full-stack and open-source experience, there is no evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions or leading technical discovery with enterprise stakeholders.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud tooling (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes)
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership via GISCollective and workshops
Proven ability to ship complex systems and mentor teams through workshops and collaborative development
concerns: No visible experience with vector databases, RAG, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI
Lacks documented work on GenAI production systems or LLM optimization metrics
No evidence of enterprise customer-facing technical leadership or AI prototyping-to-production transitions
